en: Leave the camp and join the alps
Load the prey onto your horse
Test your bow on the wolves
Reach the source of the screams
Surrender your weapons at the gate
Lose your pursuers in the crowd
Find a path across the rooftops
Find the letter in Nasir's chamber
Gather the four pieces of evidence
Present the evidence at the council
Erase your tracks in the snow
Walk the forest with Geyikli Baba
Forge the sword to the rhythm of zikr
Bind the sword to your hand
Position the alps at three points
Shatter the shield with Rage Strike
Clear the Cavdar road of bandits
Land the finisher when Faith is full
Greet the spring and the new homeland

uz: Bizni nega qutqardingiz? Siz bizni tanimaysiz.
Begunohga qilich kotarilgan joyda men jim turolmayman.
en: Where a blade is raised against the innocent, I cannot stay silent.
I want to know who is hunting you.
Until you say who you are, trust is difficult.
Your father's voice is in your words.

uz: Bilganingiz sizni ham xavf ostiga qoyadi.
en: Knowing will put you in danger too.

uz: Ehtiyot bolish aybmas. Lekin biz dushman emasmiz.
tr: Ihtiyat kusur degil. Ama biz dusman degiliz.
en: Caution is no fault. But we are not your enemy.
A guest is a trust from God.

uz: Shorva tayyor! Kiyik emas, lekin qorin toydiradi.
Kengash ochildi. Kim nima desa, dalili bilan aytsin.
en: The council is open. Let each man speak with proof.

uz: Obamizda xoin bor. Men uni aytaman.
en: There is a traitor in our camp. I will name him.

uz: Nosir xonasidan olingan xat - Qayi muhri bilan.
en: The letter from Nasir's chamber, with the Kayi seal.

uz: Muhr nusxasi. Uni faqat bir kishi yasay olardi.
en: A copy of the seal. Only one man could have made it.

uz: Selcan Xotun tunda kim bilan gaplashganini aytdi.
en: Selcan Hatun told me whom he met at night.

uz: Aykiz osha tunni korgan yagona guvoh.
en: Aykiz is the only witness of that night.
I have no proof, but I know.

uz: Bir varaq qogoz bilan qon qardoshingni ayblaysanmi?
en: You accuse your blood brother over a scrap of paper?
Any smith could forge that seal!
I... I did not know what I was doing.

uz: Men uni osha tunda tegirmon yolida kordim.
tr: Onu o gece degirmen yolunda gordum.
en: I saw him on the mill road that night.

uz: Koryapsizmi? Bolaning gazabidan boshqa hech nima yoq.
en: You see? Nothing but a boy's anger.

uz: Endi hukm meniki. Nima deysan, oglim?
en: The judgement is mine now. What do you say, my son?
Put him on trial, let the camp see.
There is only one penalty for a traitor.

uz: Bey! Yigitni ogirlashdi! Amanos tomonga olib ketishdi!
en: Bey! Yigit has been taken! They rode toward Amanos!

uz: Temir keltirdingmi? Ayt, nima yasay: o'q, zirh, qilich, qalqon.
tr: Demir getirdin mi? Soyle, ne yapayim: ok, zirh, kilic, kalkan.
en: Did you bring iron? Say what I should forge: arrows, armor, sword, shield.

uz: Bo'ldi, olov sovumasidan ol. Alloh yordamching bo'lsin, Ertug'rul.
tr: Tamam, ates sogumadan al. Allah yardimcin olsun Ertugrul.
en: Done. Take it before the fire cools. May God be your helper, Ertugrul.

uz: Ertug'rul... Men Ulukayin, hayot daraxtiman. Uch belgini topding. Endi jumboqimga javob ber.
tr: Ertugrul... Ben Ulukayin, hayat agaciyim. Uc isareti buldun. Simdi bilmeceme cevap ver.
en: Ertugrul... I am Ulukayin, the tree of life. You found the three signs. Now answer my riddle.

uz: Qilichdan o'tkir, oltindan qimmat, yo'qotsang qaytmas. Bu nima?
tr: Kilictan keskin, altindan degerli, kaybedersen geri gelmez. Nedir?
en: Sharper than a sword, dearer than gold, lost and never returned. What is it?

uz: Qanoti yo'q, lekin uchadi; og'zi yo'q, lekin butun obani uyg'otadi. Bu nima?
tr: Kanadi yok ama ucar; agzi yok ama butun obayi uyandirir. Nedir?
en: No wings yet it flies; no mouth yet it wakes the whole tribe. What is it?

uz: Bir ota - ko'p o'g'il; o'g'illari bir bo'lsa tog'ni ko'chiradi, ayrilsa qamishdek sinadi. Bu nima?
tr: Bir baba - cok ogul; ogullar bir olsa dagi tasir, ayrilsa kamis gibi kirilir. Nedir?
en: One father, many sons; united they move mountains, divided they snap like reeds. What is it?
A bundle of arrows (the tribe's unity)

uz: To'g'ri. Uyg'onganingda kuchingni to'liq topasan. Yo'ling ochiq bo'lsin.
tr: Dogru. Uyandiginda gucunu tam bulacaksin. Yolun acik olsun.
en: Correct. When you wake, your strength will be whole. May your road be open.

uz: Yo'q... Hali o'rganishing kerak. Tush tugadi, uyg'on.
tr: Hayir... Daha ogrenmen gerek. Ruya bitti, uyan.
en: No... You still have much to learn. The dream ends. Wake.
I donate 100 gold to the tribe
I donate 5 meat to the tribe
I donate 3 leather to the tribe

uz: Alloh rozi bo'lsin, o'g'lim. Oba kuchayadi, alplar ko'payadi.
tr: Allah razi olsun oglum. Oba guclenir, alpler cogalir.
en: May God be pleased with you, my son. The tribe grows stronger, the alps more numerous.
